description: Lights arriving after a lot loads, at night: the camera jumps across the 10 lots with the most Sims on them (homes with their lamps lit, re-ranked every loop) and holds still 10 s at each, twice round, and the window is recorded (-Grab). flash_scan's settle.csv counts per jump the light changes while the camera is still and when they stopped. The first 24 s after the load are left alone (the loading screen fades out). Off (the game alone) against on. Run with -Grab, without -Profiler; the save loads at 21:14 and the run ends before dawn. The mod's background frame limit is lifted: the runner never focuses the game, so it would cap every run. The mod shows the game in a 3200x1800 window for the run: a borderless window over the whole screen can be shown by independent flip, which the window recording reads as black frames.
